steps.text: Babel Interior, Rim Billiton PLC Branch Office at Babel

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Savage, are you busy...?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Huh? Amiya, you're early here today.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: There's no goods that need delivering today, and I've got nothing too urgent to deal with.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What's the matter, Amiya? Nothing on your plate today either?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Today, the Doctor, Kal'tsit, and Theresa went outside, and they wanted me to stay by myself in my room for now... and then they'd all come back at dinner.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I don't know what I should even do, alone in my room...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hmmm—hm, so you decided to sneak out and look for me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: *Sigh*. That's just how adults are, always tormented by work they can't finish. Not to mention those three make everyone wonder how much of a tireless 'workaholic' someone can be...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Does everyone become like that after they grow up?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Not really... some people are forced to be, but there are actual people who believe, from the bottom of their hearts, how diving all the way into work enriches their life.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What kind are you, then, Miss Savage?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Me, eh...? When I'm working, I do my part properly until I'm done. I guess I decently like it?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But I can relax right now, so of course it'd be even more fun to be with you!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: That's right, Amiya, why don't we take advantage of today to try and cook something?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Cook?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You can learn to make your most favorite Rim Billiton foods, like... carrot pie! Don't you wanna see what it's like to make it?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Cooking and baking are the greatest pick-me-ups for loads of people, and you'd be hard-pressed to tear them from it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I get to make carrot pie with Savage...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmhm, I want to make some!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Alright, then, let's make some together.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The Doctor mentioned loving it too when we tried some together, so let's make a pie for when the Doctor comes back, and all three of us can enjoy it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's wonderful...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Good! We're settled, then.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Follow me, Amiya. The carrots I asked from a work friend are in the kitchen freezer, plus we've got cheese, and the fowl eggs should be in...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Savage, I cracked the fowl eggs!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: That quick? Lemme see...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Er.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: (How'd half the egg whites go missing...? And all the shells are broken in there, too...)

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Um, not... not too shabby. Let me just process it a bit more, and we can put them right in...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: D—Did I do bad...?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wh-What do you mean? Haha. This is your first time cooking, Amiya. You're just not that used to it.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right, Amiya, could you wash the carrots for me? Mm-hm, the ones right there in the basket...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Aaah, you don't need to wash that many! Good, just like that...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hold on, you don't need your fingernails for carrots, you can just use a vegetable peeler... it's normal for them to be all bumpy. First time, after all.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's a bit hard, kneading dough. Just leave that to me...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: No, let me set the oven, yeah? That's a little much to ask for now...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wait, Amiya, that's not how you clean up flour—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough*... Waah, Savage, help me...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Pff... pff, haha...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Waaah, my eyes hurt...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Sorry, sorry, let me wipe them off for you now... *cough*, kfah-*cough*, kah-haha...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stop making fun of me!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'm not making fun of you! Pff... You're just being extra adorable right now, that's all, Amiya. Oh, man, I want a memento of this to keep forever.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But you've got the flour all over you, now. Let's take you to tidy up first, yeah...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: N-No, the pie's most important right now... it'll be awful if we can't finish it in time!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Savage, let's wait until we're done to tidy!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Haha, alright then. Amiya, come here, let me wipe your face off for you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Once we've got the pie done and in the oven, we'll go and have a good wash...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Phew. Not too bad, and not a moment to lose.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Look, three pies, baked in the nick of time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmhm, they smell so good...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Now we just need to sprinkle a little sugar on top and keep them warm, and that's a job very well done for us.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Come to mention it... I remember the Doctor was fond of particular tastes when it came to food. Amiya, do you have any idea?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmhm! I remember all the things the Doctor likes about food. And... I remember about all the food you like too, Savage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What's this, what's this? You've been remembering things about me this whole time?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hehe... because you've been so nice looking after me, and when I see you eating something you really like, I get really happy too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I want to remember about everything that makes you happy!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And also, I want to keep making all kinds of really nice food with you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So, it... it'd be nice if we could stay together forever... just like the Doctor, I hope I can have fun with Savage forever...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: B-But, if you have work to do, then you should do it! I know work is very important...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'll be with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Really. It's okay, Amiya, we're already super, super good friends.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Cautus sisters should love each other and live together, helping each all the way. So...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... Dr. Kal'tsit said, before long, Babel and Rim Billiton PLC are going to finish their cooperative project, and then Savage would...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You already know, huh?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Yes, it's true. After that, I'll probably be heading back to work in Rim Billiton for a while.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'm already an adult, so there are responsibilities I have to bear. Right now, Rim Billiton still has some things I need to finish.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But I'll come back to see you as soon as possible, Amiya. No matter how far apart we are, we're friends. So long as you need me to help, your big sis Savage'll come protect you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmhm... I know.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right. Right, then, let's drop this subject. Who knows if Rim Billiton'll forget about me, and they won't call me back in, and I'll be stuck as an unemployed drifter...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Maybe, if you keep at your studies, Amiya, you'll be like a VIP in future, and you'll start your own big company, and then I'll be one of your employees, yeah?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whuh? My own company...? Um, could I do that...?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Start putting in the effort now, and you'll get the chance one day, guaranteed.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The Doctor, Kal'tsit, Theresa, they're all especially mighty people. Make sure you learn well from your teachers, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmhm, I know. You're very mighty too, Savage. When you were in Rim Billiton—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: No way, no way, I can't compare to those bunch...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're a super mighty teacher to me, Savage! You can make really nice food for me, you do work really well, and you've told me so many stories from Rim Billiton...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also, I know, you like keeping me company... you look after me just like a real big sister would.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know it'll be very scary when you leave... but, cooking today made me really happy. Thanks to this memory, I won't be so scared in the future.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Same for me, Amiya. Coming to Babel, getting to see you all happy finding me for a chat, playing together, cooking... I've been so glad all this time.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So, knowing we're about to part, I'm gonna be very sad too.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But, I won't ever let you look at me and worry.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya, living upon this vast world, each of us has things we need to do.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You'll find your own direction, your own forward in the future, I promise. If we have the same beliefs... we'll definitely see each other again.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'll strive to move forward. Amiya, you too...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Grow up safe and sound.
A normal, unremarkable day.
Amiya has sought you out surprisingly early, bringing up the Rim Billiton delicacies coming this noon with expectation in her voice.
Obviously, after the privilege of five healthy meals in a row, it's a very hard invitation to resist.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've been looking forward to this 'banquet' for forever. Savage will meet almost any request I have, but it's cooking alone where she won't budge an inch.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No formal invitations until all the ingredients were completely ready. Not the slightest thing could be lacking.

options: Savage is especially considerate of you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hehe... she's always had me act like such a spoiled child towards her. Besides, Savage makes such tasty food.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, its taste might be on the tame side for some Operators, but it suits my palate very well. How do I put it? It has a flavor that brings back memories of the home you came from...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, but I'm sure you'll like it too, Doctor. After all...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not really! I just wanted to share this with you... Savage welcomes you as a special guest, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've been friends with Savage since long, long ago, so I know the food she makes is going to be delicious!

options: You say 'we'... Savage said she remembered me, but couldn't say much more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's true, she knew you then, and made you Rim Billiton delicacies many times before, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No need to worry, Doctor. To me and Savage both, you're someone utterly dependable, and worthy of trust.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I expect she's looking forward to this meal as a gift for you too, Doctor, for meeting once again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She isn't just adept at food preparation, she's also very exact with raw ingredients too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm... but I have no idea why tinned carrots from Rim Billiton were so hard to buy this year. They were the most important ingredient...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It wasn't just rising prices. Procurement channels have dropped off, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For Rim Billitonians, carrots are essentially a most beloved food, and demand far outstrips supply for them on the market. They get even scarcer when you want to order goods you can send to Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course, more places besides Rim Billiton grow carrots. There'll be all sorts of different varieties in places all unalike. But Savage said...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'If it's not Rim Billiton's sweet, crisp kind, it's not gonna do, Amiya. I'll have you tasting the delicacy from your memories, just you wait!'

options: Hearing that's making me drool, too.
Carrots have their own fierce pride, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha... I'm looking forward to it, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Savage and I haven't seen each other in so long.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the fact she's still willing to treat me like she did in the past, that... really reassures me...
...Sit yourself... down!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Eep!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That voice came from the dining hall... did something happen to Savage in there?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Aaah—hmp! ...Delish! Thank you for the food, Savage!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: (Rapid chewing)

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, fine, you're welcome.

steps.name: April
steps.text: Th-This pie tastes so... so professional.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heh-heh... no surprises there, no surprises. There's no one out there who can brush off my handiwork.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: April, you want to try some of mine too? It's all the rage in Victorian eating right now, you just take anything and dump loaaads—and loads of ketchup on it!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: No! You've already used up two whole bottles on this! You can't even taste the original flavor anymore, you naughty little kid!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Heheh, how about you try my special portion then, Ayers? It's the taste of innovation!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I always abide by the original flavors. Eat your grotesquely revised pie yourself...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Huh? Don't be a bore, Ayers! Get a little more creativity in you.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: When we were in Victoria, every time we went to a restaurant, we'd see customers ordering a pie just like this, and then squeezing at least four ketchup packets onto it.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: 'The healthiest part of the food's actually the complimentary ketchup sachets,' didn't they always say that at all the fast food places?

steps.name: April
steps.text: You are not comparing Savage's pie to a fast food joint.

steps.name: April
steps.text: Everything about it's so perfect, from the heat control to the aroma...

steps.name: April
steps.text: I feel like it's been ages since I tried this flavor. It's a scent you'd get while running around outside... is it nostalgia, maybe...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Yeah? I think it's pretty good, right?

steps.name: April
steps.text: How is it you have no idea how to read the mood?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Leon's trying to say that as a Catastrophe Messenger, he's already used to a life of long spates without any Rim Billiton food available. Being too dependent on your home's dishes... makes it hard to carry on outside.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: That's right. By the way, let me tell you something cool, April, while we were traveling out there, we saw another way to eat pie, where you have to grab it with your hands, and then you jump into the air—

steps.name: April
steps.text: Wagh! Careful, you're gonna drop it, you're gonna drop the pie...!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hol—Hold on, other people are still working right now, settle down a little... Leonhardt, sit still!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Aw, okay...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Excuse me...

steps.name: April & Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Whoa, it's Amiya and the Doctor—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So you were all dining, then.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: No, we weren't, this was, uh, Savage inviting us for a 'taste-of-home sampling party'...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You've made such a mess of the dining hall. Sorry, Amiya, Doctor, I'll tidy it all up soon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's okay, we're here to sample Savage's culinary delicacies, too. Let's all clean up afterwards.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Egg on your face, Leon.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I thought it'd be fine to act a little cool with just us four... April, I'll show you that special eating method next time.
